The core duality lies between data availability and legal usability. The system's integrity depends on resolving conflicts among sources while maintaining trust. A Bayesian framework models trust as a function of source credibility and conflict resolution. The licensed data access model acts as a constraint on the data space, ensuring only compliant data enters the pipeline. The UX layer must compress this information into a 10-second narrative, requiring a minimal sufficient statistic that captures trust, coverage, and missing data. Failure modes include overconfidence in low-quality sources, underutilization of high-value licensed data, and misalignment between data structure and user expectations.
